course_name_original: Introdução à análise de dados em Excel
course_name_en: Introduction to data analysis in Excel

learning_outcomes.text: Understanding the essential concepts of data analysis and management.
Solving problems involving a large volume of data, namely using data series available at Pordata, INE and others.

syllabus_topics: Types of information (numeric values, formulas and text)
teaching_methods: Asynchronous self-learning with consultation of videos and documents
Access to bibliographical references and various links, exercises and online quizzes
assessment_rules: Assessment methods are based on a distributed component (quizzes) and a final in-person exam. Students are admitted to the final exam if they have obtained a grade higher than 85% in the transition tests. The final grade is calculated as 100% based on the final exam. For special assessment, approval in a distributed component (Final Quiz in Moodle) is required in the 15 days prior to the exam date, in addition to the final in-class test.
